title: Elijah calls down fire against the priests of Baal

tellings.quote: the Bible who did something similar calling down lightning. He had a battle of the against the priests of Bal to see whether our god or their god would uh light this sacrificial fire.

plain: In the Bible, the prophet Elijah held a contest against the priests of Baal, a rival god, to see whose god would light a sacrifice, and he called down fire from the sky to win it. A researcher named Jeffrey Mishlove brings up the story, describing it as calling down lightning, to compare it with something similar he was discussing. He tells it as an example of a person seeming to command a force of nature.
